scope: Pre-render review of five 600-second, 1920x1080 tutorial compositions at 115 BPM and 60 output fps.

prior_visual_review.provenance: Coverage reported by the coordinating agent; not re-performed in this final pass.
prior_visual_review.revision: Before the final localized fixes. The no-sheets audit intentionally does not rebuild those older contact sheets.

final_visual_review.method: Direct visual inspection of full-resolution 1920x1080 critical beat captures. Two frames were inspected again after the final Q-label/caption adjustment.

frames.focus: RL return arrow clears the four tiles and explanatory line.
Pipeline CYCLE 0 and completion text are distinct.
Pipeline CYCLE 6, completion cycles 4/5/6 and all filled stages read clearly.
All three distance bars, shared-scale legend and stopping-distance qualification are separated.
Packet context, three pending verdicts and authentication qualification are separated.
frames.revision: before and after last global caption adjustment

frames.focus: ACCEPT / STALE / DUPLICATE are visible and correctly associated with the three packets.
Initial PC is 100; accumulator and destination remain unwritten.
After first fetch, PC is 101 and LOAD is the current instruction.
Q update reaches 3.3; the midpoint annotation now clears the pink marker. Two-line caption stays above the safe boundary.
frames.revision: before and after final Q-label and caption adjustment

frames.focus: Final Q result uses supported text: Q: 2 to 3.3.
Final delay result uses supported text: 500 ms to 15 m.
HALT state shows PC 104, ACC 7 and memory[200] 7.

determinism.method: Compare JPEG SHA-256 and diagnostic SHA-256 in forward and reverse seek order, including each scene at +0.05s, +0.4s, +2s and midpoint, plus endpoints.

loop_endpoints.result: All six endpoint source samples match within each video. The exact ffmpeg three-sample blend produces byte-identical first and last raw yuv420p output frames.
loop_endpoints.scope: This checks blended render endpoints; the full delivery MP4 has not been encoded or decoded by this pass.

fixed_in_final_pass: Moved the Q midpoint annotation from baseline 742 to 720 to clear its marker.
Moved caption baselines to 913 and 962, keeping their diagnostic bottom at or below 971.5.
Stopped drawing shrinking tile labels when their available dimensions are too small, and rejected invalid text sizes.
limitations: This is AI-assisted static-frame review, not a human teammate viewing, peer-feedback session, or rehearsal.
All final beat frames were audited automatically; only the 14 specified image inspections were performed in this final pass. Prior contact-sheet review belongs to an earlier revision.
Diagnostic text rectangles are approximate. Masked transitions contain hidden old/new states, so their 314 rectangle intersections are recorded separately rather than treated as visible collisions.
Secondary footer text has a 23px minimum size; no phone-width readability claim is made.
Beat sampling and limited seek tests cannot establish every intermediate animation frame, complete temporal-blur quality, or full-motion pacing.
Audio was not listened to or measured in this preflight. Full delivery encoding, metadata, decode integrity and audio validation remain post-render checks.
